description: Get an ERC-20 token balance for an address, returned both raw and human-readable (uses the token's decimals and symbol).

address.description: Holder address or ENS name to check

chain.description: Chain to query. Accepts a slug (eth, base, arb, op, robinhood…), a common name (ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bsc), or a numeric chain ID (1, 8453). Call list_chains for all valid values.

name: get_token_balance
